# UI assets (Lane B)

## Kenney Interface Sounds 1.0 and Impact Sounds 1.0

- Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds and https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds, created and distributed by Kenney (www.kenney.nl), downloaded 2026-10-21.
- Licence: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0), https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/. Crediting Kenney is not required; we credit anyway. The licence text of each pack is saved next to its files.
- Files kept (only the ones the product plays), under `apps/web/public/assets/ui/kenney/`:
  - `impact-sounds/`: `impactPlate_medium_000.ogg` (your stone lands), `impactPlate_light_000.ogg` (the opponent's stone lands).
  - `interface-sounds/`: `confirmation_002.ogg` (win), `error_004.ogg` (loss), `toggle_002.ogg` (draw), `tick_002.ogg` (refused move).
- Used by: Four in a Row (`apps/web/src/games/four/sounds.ts`).
